class.name: LayoutManager
class.brief_description: Base class for layout strategies (linear / grid / staggered / custom).
class.description:
LayoutManager is the port of [i]RecyclerView.LayoutManager[/i]. It defines the layout strategy used to position items and to decide which positions are visible. Use one of the concrete subclasses ([b]LinearLayoutManager[/b], [b]GridLayoutManager[/b], [b]StaggeredGridLayoutManager[/b]) for the common layouts — or extend this class in GDScript to implement your own: override [method _on_layout_children] (required) and the other [code]_*[/code] virtuals below. See [method _on_layout_children] for the full contract.
A custom layout does not scroll or recycle by itself. The [b]RecyclerView[/b] owns the scroll offset: it re-runs [method _on_layout_children] after every offset change, and clamps the offset against [method _get_content_size]. The script positions holders through the RecyclerView's public API ([method RecyclerView.get_view_for_position], [method RecyclerView.add_item_view], [method RecyclerView.set_item_view_position], [method RecyclerView.remove_item_view], [method RecyclerView.recycle_view]) and reads the inputs through [method get_item_count], [method RecyclerView.get_scroll_offset], [method RecyclerView.get_viewport_size] and [method RecyclerView.get_item_extent].

method.name: _can_scroll_horizontally
method.description: Returns whether the list can scroll horizontally (default false). Mirrors Android's [b]LayoutManager.canScrollHorizontally[/b]. Drives horizontal gestures and the scroll bar.

method.name: _can_scroll_vertically
method.description: Returns whether the list can scroll vertically (default false). Mirrors Android's [b]LayoutManager.canScrollVertically[/b]. Drives vertical gestures and the scroll bar.

method.name: _collect_adjacent_prefetch_positions
method.description: Returns positions just ahead of the viewport in the scroll direction (positive [code]dy[/code] = scrolling down/right) so the RecyclerView can pre-create their views into the recycled pool. Mirrors Android's [b]LayoutManager.collectAdjacentPrefetchPositions[/b]. Use [method get_recycler_view] to inspect the list. Optional: without it, no prefetch happens.

method.name: _get_content_size
method.description: Returns the content size along the scroll axis (default 0, which clamps the list to one viewport). Mirrors Android's [b]LayoutManager.computeVerticalScrollRange[/b]. The RecyclerView clamps the scroll offset to [code]content − viewport[/code] with this value, so it must cover every position the layout can show.

method.name: _get_item_rect
method.description: Returns the item's rect in viewport space (before decoration insets). Mirrors Android's [b]LayoutManager.getDecoratedBoundsWithMargins[/b]. Used by ItemDecorations (dividers, spacing) and the item animator. Optional.

method.name: _get_position_offset
method.description: Returns the scroll offset at which the item starts, in content space (default 0). Mirrors Android's [b]LayoutManager.getPositionOffset[/b]. Drives [method RecyclerView.scroll_to_position] and the SnapHelpers. A wrong value misplaces scroll-to-position, so implement it whenever the item offsets are not uniform.

method.name: _on_data_changed
method.description: Called when the adapter contents change, so cached layout state (e.g. a position table) can be invalidated before the next layout. Mirrors Android's [b]LayoutManager.onItemsChanged[/b]. Optional.

method.name: _on_layout_children
get_content_size
method.description: Returns the content size along the scroll axis. The base dispatches to [method _get_content_size] (default 0); the concrete managers compute it internally.

method.name: get_item_count
method.description: Returns the adapter's item count (0 when no adapter is set).

method.name: get_position_offset
method.description: Returns the item's starting scroll offset in content space. The base dispatches to [method _get_position_offset] (default 0); the concrete managers compute it internally.

method.name: get_recycler_view
method.description: Returns the [b]RecyclerView[/b] this layout is attached to.

method.name: get_reverse_layout
method.description: Returns whether reverse layout is enabled.

method.name: set_reverse_layout
method.description: Enables reverse layout: items are laid out from the trailing end (bottom for a vertical list). Combined with an initial scroll to the max offset this gives a chat list where position 0 sits at the bottom.
